attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 7.9), installed yum-plugin-versionlock (via the rhel-7-server-rpms repo, enabled for this purpose) and added a versionlock entry for the installed curl-7.29.0-59.el7 package. Verified with a real newer curl build available in the repo (7.29.0-59.el7_9.2) that an explicit `yum update curl` is blocked ("No packages marked for update"), and that in a mixed update transaction (curl + less + gzip) curl was silently excluded while less and gzip genuinely updated — proving the hold survives a system update. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and versionlock/curl state, issued `shutdown -r now`, polled until the node came back, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified curl version and versionlock protection post-restart (still correctly blocking updates).
